items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Papa would listen to him, and say, "Hey, Mister Henry, my rubber heels is kind of wearing here."

ctx.x: My Daddy's name was Henry. My mother's name was Alice; her maiden name was Bargeron(?). And all of my ancestors come from France, on both sides of my family.
Your folks were born and raised in Baton Rouge, too?
